businessProfile.productSummary: B2B SaaS that automates patient-recall and appointment-reminder workflows for dental practices.
businessProfile.brandVoice: professional, clinical, trust-focused (emphasize compliance, reliability, ROI)

assumptions: This is sold to dental practice decision-makers (dentists, practice owners, office managers) rather than consumers.
Pricing is subscription/annual-contract based (not single consumer retail purchases).
Primary market is dental practices in the U.S.
clarifyingQuestions: Who is the primary buyer (dentist/owner, practice manager, corporate group) and what is a typical contract value or ARR per customer?
What is your primary marketing objective (lead generation for demos, free-trial signups, direct sales to corporate groups)?
Which geographies and practice sizes do you target (solo practices vs DSOs; U.S. only or international)?
Which channels have worked best so far (trade publications, LinkedIn, industry events, email outreach, reseller partnerships)?
